title: Exclude funded P104 donor fusion (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On exact #7314, restoring role 1355's direct rank-six transport could save at most 0.16685897749686654 raw units on the complete signed 17-copy invoice, with the productive histogram fixed. The directed price is positive before support. An extra raw rank-one paid position would erase it.

The removed chart-240 ADD would contribute −8 at output coordinate 1109. Every eligible new public chart-240 recipient response during the second cache lifetime has exactly zero there. Exact rational elimination exhausted 1,003 recipient visits, with 39 distinct columns and rank 25. A separate exact covector checked all 82 chart-boundary cuts, covering 59 role/contact classes. All allowed rational combinations are excluded, compatible saving is zero, and zero cases remain unresolved in this scope.

## Task, overlap and replay

Round 65 of [Discussion #7111](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7111), with exact #7314 at 9d0119eb12fbd9fa534b48cd37b68e7099757b91 and the unchanged #7113 signed caller. The scope keeps both stationary caches and the other fifteen corrections. It differs from earlier local paid-fusion and abstract rank-price results because it tests the full output response of the missing correction. Source synthesis on the outer charts, a changed cache lifetime, and changed chronology are separate scopes. This branch retains the #7257 replay prerequisites.

~~~sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-funded-donor-fusion-span/replay.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-funded-donor-fusion-span
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-funded-donor-fusion-span --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

The standalone replay regenerates exact price, span and covector receipts. Changed caller and stale price are rejected. Local registered replay, committed bytes and modes, Git-free export and six navigation tests passed. No candidate entered a native or outer replay gate.

## Credit

#7314 supplied the funded return, cache and paid split. #7277 supplied the original direct route, #7113 the signed caller, #7298 the directed tariff, and #7319/#7332 the pricing adapters. #7312 and #7326 supplied related fusion and pricing precedents. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.
